steps.name: Install Doxygen
steps.run:
archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/doxygen.tar.gz"
curl --fail --location --retry 3 "https://github.com/doxygen/doxygen/releases/download/Release_${DOXYGEN_VERSION//./_}/doxygen-$DOXYGEN_VERSION.linux.bin.tar.gz" --output "$archive"
echo "$DOXYGEN_SHA256  $archive" | sha256sum --check
tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/doxygen-$DOXYGEN_VERSION/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/doxygen-$DOXYGEN_VERSION/bin/doxygen" --version

steps.name: Locate the C++ project
Build API reference
steps.run:
doxygen Doxyfile
# Doxygen can exit 0 after writing nothing (for example an INPUT
# that matches no file), so check the outputs that are published.
test -s docs/api/html/index.html
test -s docs/api/xml/index.xml

steps.name: Assemble site
steps.run:
if [ "$MULTI_LANGUAGE" = "true" ]; then
  mkdir -p _site
  cp -R "$HTML_DIR" _site/cpp
  printf '<!doctype html><meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0; url=cpp/index.html">\n' > _site/index.html
else
  cp -R "$HTML_DIR" _site
fi
touch _site/.nojekyll
find _site -maxdepth 2 -name 'index.html' -print

steps.name: Report skipped GitHub Pages deployment
steps.run: echo "::notice::Skipping GitHub Pages deployment. To enable publishing, set Settings -> Pages -> Source = GitHub Actions, then add repository variable DEPLOY_GITHUB_PAGES=true."

steps.name: Install pinned lint tools
steps.run:
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check -r scripts/requirements-ci.txt
clang-format --version
clang-tidy --version
cppcheck --version

steps.name: Collect changed files
steps.run:
{
  echo 'files<<CHANGED_FILES_EOF'
  if [ -n "$BASE_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then
    git diff --name-only "$BASE_SHA" HEAD
  else
    # No usable base (e.g. workflow_dispatch): fall back to annotating every warning.
    git ls-files
  fi
  echo 'CHANGED_FILES_EOF'
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Select the compiler and locate the C++ project
steps.run:
{
  if [ -n "$MATRIX_CC" ]; then
    echo "CC=$MATRIX_CC"
    echo "CXX=$MATRIX_CXX"
  fi
  echo "CPP_DIR=$(python scripts/get_version.py --print cpp_root)"
  echo "SCRIPTS_DIR=$PWD/scripts"
} >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
cmake --version

steps.name: Build and test (Debug)
steps.run: bash "$SCRIPTS_DIR/run-with-budget-warning.sh" "$TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS" "Debug build and tests" cmake --workflow --preset dev

steps.run: bash "$SCRIPTS_DIR/run-with-budget-warning.sh" "$TEST_BUDGET_SECONDS" "Release build and tests" cmake --workflow --preset release

steps.name: Run release script tests

steps.name: Restore the NuGet package with the NuGet client
Build and test the Conan package
steps.run:
conan profile detect --force
bash scripts/run-with-budget-warning.sh "$CONAN_BUDGET_SECONDS" "Conan package" \
  conan create "$CPP_DIR" -s compiler.cppstd=20 --build=missing

steps.name: Read the pinned vcpkg baseline

python3 -c 'import json, sys; print("baseline=" + json.load(open(sys.argv[1]))["builtin-baseline"])' "$cpp_dir/vcpkg.json" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
